title: Basisfarben
slide_intent: Separate backgrounds from text colors so hierarchy and legibility remain predictable.
strategic_value: A stable neutral foundation can keep DB messages clear while leaving room for red and Lilac accents.
demonstration: Two subsections pair White/Cold Black background swatches with White/Black type swatches and describe the Cold Black exception.
practical_value: Choose the neutral field and its contrasting text color before adding expressive accents.

content_islands.name: Background roles
content_islands.spec: Present Cold Black and White as the layout-surface pair under the first subheading.

content_islands.name: Typography roles
content_islands.spec: Present White and Black below, with Cold Black described as an alternative for large expressive text.

reference_purposes.Intent: The text connects the neutral and type roles to clarity and contrast.
reference_purposes.Application: It assigns surface colors and opposing light/dark text choices.
reference_purposes.Constraint: Cold Black is presented as an alternative to Black for large text and expressive advertising, not a universal text replacement.

ingredient.name: Neutral color roles
ingredient.role: Support readable hierarchy without competing with identity accents.
ingredient.application: Use White/Cold Black for surfaces and White/Black for type; consider Cold Black for the stated large expressive text use.
ingredient.scope: General base-color guidance; more restrictive headline wording appears in the later do/don’t section.
